about: How the opening made each value dev mode's "How this world opened" shows (src/bench/dev-views/opening.ts). From the opening audit of Nov 16, 2026: every seeded draw and table read a New Game world takes, recorded by line at Loudon NH, St. Louis MO and Cambridge MN (the Account lead's report opening-draws-and-fixed-values, in the project's shared folder). A row changes in the same pull request that changes how the opening makes its value.

kinds.world-offset: World offset from a published figure
kinds.ad-hoc-draw: Drawn with no record behind it
kinds.constant: Fixed number, same in every world

town.population.by: src/core2/gov-rules/place-population.ts worldPopulationOf: the published count moved by the world's offset (worldPopulationSpreadShare)

town.jobsMix.by: src/core2/town-employment-mix.ts townWorkplaceWeights: County Business Patterns mix moved by the world's offset (jobsWorldSectorMixSpreadShare)

town.employersOfKind.by: src/core2/town-workplaces.ts outlets per kind of workplace (labeled GAME ASSUMPTIONS)
town.employersOfKind.replace: Count from the town's workers and the county's average business size (thread "Size each town's stores and clinics")

town.householdMix.by: src/core2/household-mix.ts: the place's ACS household shares, or its state's where the place has none

town.presidentApproval.by: src/core2/modules/national-opinion.ts reads openingPct (41) from src/core2/data/electorate/national-opinion.json; its own spread is 36 to 45
town.presidentApproval.replace: A world offset inside the row's spread

person.name.by: src/core2/person-names.ts and src/core2/gov-rules/given-name-cohorts.ts: given names by birth-year cohort; family names picked evenly from the whole name list (own random stream)
person.name.replace: Family names weighted by how common they are, on the world's seeded unit

person.birthDate.by: src/core2/population.ts from the place's survey sample; invented people in src/core2/gov-rules/invented-person-age.ts fall only on days 1 to 28

person.trait.by: src/core2/opening-personality.ts: the facet's spread by age and upbringing, drawn with its own random stream (Box-Muller)
person.trait.replace: The world's seeded unit keyed by person and trait

person.cash.by: src/core2/starting-cash.ts: SCF 2022 transaction accounts by income; counted households in src/core2/counted-money.ts drew from a hash with 8 times too many extremes
person.cash.replace: Renters thread: the world's seeded unit

person.job.by: src/core2/opening-employment.ts and src/core2/opening-town-jobs.ts: the town's job mix, hires ordered by a hash; pay from the 25th to the 75th percentile over 20 years (prototype numbers)
person.job.replace: Order on the world's seeded unit; pay by tenure from BLS

person.birthplace.by: src/core2/nativity.ts: a roll against the share born in state; many are written as born at home (stopgap SG-HIST-birthplace-is-home)
person.birthplace.replace: The parents' record and the moves pass

person.knownPeople.by: src/core2/opening-ties.ts: who among the eligible people is a tie is picked by a hash order; coworker groups of 8
person.knownPeople.replace: Ties from shared records: household, school class, workplace, block

person.conditions.by: src/core2/modules/health.ts lateConditions and resilienceLine: a hash against each condition's rate
person.conditions.replace: The world's seeded unit keyed by person and condition

household.members.by: src/core2/population.ts from the place's survey households; town skeletons in src/core2/town-households.ts use typed ranges (partner within 6 years, 1 to 3 children)
household.members.replace: ACS household size and age tables

household.memberAge.by: src/core2/population.ts and src/core2/town-households.ts (children's ages even between typed bounds)
household.memberAge.replace: ACS age tables by household kind

household.since.by: src/core2/opening-tenure.ts: years in place from the mover rates, own random stream

business.kind.by: src/core2/town-employment-mix.ts: the county's County Business Patterns industries

business.cash.by: src/core2/opening-capital.ts openingEmployerCashBufferPrior: days of cash by industry, placed by a hash
business.cash.replace: The world's seeded unit keyed by business

business.staff.by: src/core2/opening-town-jobs.ts: hires to the outlet with the fewest staff

office.office.by: src/core2/modules/offices.ts from the place's government records

office.holder.by: src/core2/officials-identity.ts: an invented holder; positions from src/core2/officials-roster.ts on its own hash

office.serviceStart.by: src/core2/modules/offices.ts pastTerms: years in office drawn from the office kind's mean tenure
office.serviceStart.replace: Past elections run by the election engine

office.termEnds.by: src/core2/modules/offices.ts seatTerm: the term length and start day from the place's law (src/core2/data/elections/term-starts.json); estimated where the law is not read (stopgap SG-GOV-term-end-estimate)

office.termsBefore.replace: Past elections run by the election engine

office.lastShare.by: src/core2/modules/offices.ts electionBehind: drawn evenly inside the office kind's band
office.lastShare.replace: The past race's result from the election engine
